issues.body: Section 8 still says all seventeen workflow bindings read `${{ secrets.ALERT_REPO || vars.ALERT_REPO || '' }}`. The tree has 17 `ALERT_REPO:` bindings, but only 16 use that expression; `.github/workflows/groom.yml:607` uses `${{ secrets.ALERT_REPO }}` without the variable fallback. This is the same minor imprecision reported in round 4.
issues.fix_hint: Say that 16 bindings use the secret/variable fallback expression and one is secret-only, or describe all 17 more generally as reading an `ALERT_REPO` workflow binding.
issues.title: The claimed 17 identical ALERT_REPO bindings still include one different binding

verdict.summary: The research-only change remains substantively correct and changes no runtime or trust-plane behavior. The sole prior-round minor finding is unchanged: section 8 says all seventeen workflow bindings use the secret/variable fallback expression, while the checkout has sixteen such bindings and one secret-only binding at .github/workflows/groom.yml:607. Because the same documentation imprecision remains at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
